entries.lesson: The CFTC-only frequency gate leaves one stable center with 219 symmetric signals, but all four center/neighbor points lose gross and net in train. The central executable sample has 217 trades, gross -13.23 USDC, base PF 0.697/PnL -40.80 and stress PF 0.471/PnL -84.18.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not invert direction, remove one side, tune lookback/threshold/hold, increase leverage, or inspect 2018-2026 to rescue managed-money positioning-change continuation.
entries.next_direction: Close this CFTC continuation rule. A future XAU family must use a distinct mechanism rather than a transformation of the same positioning change.

entries.lesson: Macro frequency is structurally adequate (417/417 train weeks; 13/27 stable frequency points), and the best train point has PF 1.61 base and 1.22 conservative. At frozen stress it falls to PF 1.016, EV +0.014 USDC and only 3/8 positive years; the long side supplies +9.68 USDC while short loses -9.18.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not remove the short side post hoc, count current long rollover credit as historical profit, lower carry or execution stress, tune macro thresholds, or inspect 2015-2026 to rescue v30b or the primary v30.
entries.next_direction: Use a genuinely different causal flow or positioning input; retain delayed-publication timing and the macro-only frequency preflight.

entries.lesson: The best of 16 frozen train-only points has 30 trades and a coherent continuation tendency (8 bps PF 2.35/EV +0.59 USDC; 15 bps PF 1.56/EV +0.31), but 30-bps event stress falls to PF 0.57 and EV -0.39; 0 points survive.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not lower event stress, tune reaction windows, holds, stops or meeting types, add direction filters, or inspect 2019-2026 to rescue the FOMC-reaction family.
entries.next_direction: Require a larger-magnitude event mechanism, or measure event-time execution before a genuinely new preregistered campaign with a new development period.

entries.lesson: All 6 frozen train-only points have 1,038-1,039 trades and a small +0.86 to +1.81 gross bps tendency, but current 5 bps base execution leaves every point negative (best PF 0.68 and EV -0.18 USDC/trade); stress has zero positive years.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not tune post-fix exit hours, stops, weekdays, Gotobi filters or costs, and do not inspect 2019-2026 to rescue any Tokyo-fix timing variant.
entries.next_direction: Close the entire Tokyo-fix timing line and require a distinct mechanism with substantially larger movement per trade before StrategyQuant generation.

entries.lesson: The best of 8 frozen train-only points has 565 trades and +1.86 gross bps (+0.77 bps versus non-event days), but current 5 bps base execution reduces it to PF 0.62 and -0.25 USDC/trade; 0 points survive.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not tune Gotobi date rules, entry hour, stop or costs, and do not open 2015-2023 to rescue the pre-fix long family.
entries.next_direction: Require a mechanism with substantially larger movement per trade before StrategyQuant generation.

entries.lesson: The most selective of 12 frozen train-only points has 428 trades and a small frictionless tendency (PF 1.063, +0.031 USDC/trade), but 8 bps base execution reduces it to PF 0.21 and -0.78 USDC/trade. Erratum: the 0.10 USDC oracle is normally refunded after a successful full close and is not the primary falsifier.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not optimize thresholds, stops or exit hours, invert direction post hoc, or open 2014-2023 to rescue this family.
entries.next_direction: Require a genuinely different mechanism with larger movement per trade or materially lower fixed-cost sensitivity.

entries.lesson: The fixed VIX9D/VIX3M normalization signal has 69 development events. Hold 3 shows a mild base tendency (PF 1.13, 6/7 positive years) but stress is negative (PF 0.83, -13.15 bps/trade); holds 1 and 5 are worse.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not optimize the structural 1.0 threshold, add VIX levels, change entry timing or open 2019-2022 to rescue this signal.
entries.next_direction: Stop new SPX timing families; use VIX only as a frozen risk variable inside a genuinely different mechanism if independently justified.

entries.lesson: The best of 20 development-only points has PF 1.43 at 8 bps, but only 4/7 positive years; at 30 bps it falls to PF 1.019 and 3/7 positive years.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not relax the positive-year or stress gates, tune dates after seeing 2012-2018, or load 2019-2022 to rescue the family.
entries.next_direction: Require a genuinely new external economic input such as a preregistered volatility regime before another SPX family.

entries.lesson: Zero of 72 preregistered same-session London ORB variants pass the train gates after small-account Ostium costs.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not relax costs, sample or range parameters to rescue the family.
entries.next_direction: Change mechanism or asset while retaining the early same-session economics gate.

entries.lesson: PF temporal 1.25 no cobreix 4.5 bps + 0.10 USDC; PF net base 0.51.

entries.next_direction: Buscar més moviment brut per trade o una fricció estructural menor.

entries.lesson: Sis famílies no conserven EV positiva a costos 2x i DD <=20%; la quasi-candidata PF 1.22 en desenvolupament cau a 0.48 en validació.
entries.do_not_repeat: No relaxar costos, DD o mostra ni usar leverage sobre expectativa negativa.
entries.next_direction: Canviar font d'edge: sessió, carry/roll, breakout amb stop o cartera setmanal.

entries.do_not_repeat: No combinar components rebutjats ni relaxar PF després de veure el test.
entries.next_direction: Nova família amb més observacions i un test temporal nou.

entries.next_direction: Només reobrir amb hipòtesi de règim ex ante i OOS nou.

entries.next_direction: Canviar mecanisme o mercat i exigir repartiment per anys i direccions abans de la validació temporal cara.

entries.lesson: Sweep/reclaim, session displacement, late-session reversal, D1 inside breakout and D1 short-RSI trend pullback all failed either the frozen cost gate or independent temporal validation; 8,480 grid points plus two selected validations produced no promotable family.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not relabel these mechanisms by changing timeframe, indicator threshold, stop or target; do not infer that ATR normalization creates an edge.
entries.next_direction: Require a genuinely new economic input or causal premise, then falsify frequency and costs before SQ generation.
